## Recent Decisions
## Recent Decisions
- Issue #131 revised: TypeScript TSPLIB parser dropped; parsing stays in Rust/WASM via new `parse` export
- `parse` returns empty strings for name/comment/distance-type when input is JSON (not TSPLIB)
- TSPLIB names/comments are lowercased by the Rust parser (`read_from_str` at tsplib.rs:244/249)
- `DistanceType` has exactly 2 variants: `Euc2D` → `"EUC_2D"`, `Geo` → `"GEO"`
- JS bindings regenerated from release WASM via `npx jco transpile` (no extra flags — shim is default-on)
- Playwright MCP added to session for browser UI verification
- Download filenames use `crypto.randomUUID()` per solve so all 4 formats share one base name
- Responsive CSS leverages PicoCSS breakpoints (576px xs / 1024px lg) rather than custom em values
- Step 04 uses `.step-04-body` 2-col grid at ≥1024px (SVG map left, table+history right)
- Sentry DSN configured with `/tunnel` proxy; `sendDefaultPii: true`
- Playwright MCP used for browser verification (no playwright.config.ts — MCP tools run interactively)
